biotools.summary: ModFOLDdock is a web server that assesses the quality of protein quaternary structure models, improving upon TM-score for ranking AF2-Multimer models. It is available at https://www.reading.ac.uk/bioinf/ModFOLDdock/ and https://www.reading.ac.uk/bioinf/ModFOLD/.
